name: Brackets
description: Four corner brackets snap inward onto the point you click, the way a camera locks focus on its subject. They start out wide, close in with a small turn that unwinds as they arrive, sit square for a moment and then fade. A lighter second set marks where you let the button go. Each button has its own colour. Nothing is drawn while the pointer is only moving.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Spread
parameters.description: How far the brackets may reach from the click (px). They start inside that, and every other length except the line thickness is a share of it.

parameters.name: Lock distance
parameters.description: Where the brackets come to rest, as a share of where they start

parameters.name: Arm length
parameters.description: Length of each bracket arm, as a share of the spread. An arm is never longer than its corner's distance from the click, so the arms cannot cross

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: How long the brackets take to close in and then fade, not counting the hold (seconds)

parameters.name: Hold
parameters.description: How long the brackets sit at rest between closing in and fading. It is added on top of the duration (seconds)

parameters.name: Turn
parameters.description: How far the brackets are turned when they start, unwinding to square as they arrive (degrees)

parameters.name: Release mark
parameters.description: Strength of the smaller second set drawn when the button is released. Set it to 0 to leave the release unmarked.

parameters.name: Left button
parameters.description: Bracket colour for the left button

parameters.name: Right button
parameters.description: Bracket colour for the right button

parameters.name: Middle button
parameters.description: Bracket colour for the middle button
